scope_of_deliverables.quote: This provisional Quality Level B investigation extends the Quality Level C Subsurface Utility Engineering investigation completed under the base scope (Fee Schedule Item 1.3). The records research and Quality Level C correlation performed under the base scope shall serve as the starting point for the Level B designation and shall not repeated.
scope_of_deliverables.value: The RFQ seeks a topographic survey and a Level C Subsurface Utility Engineering (SUE) investigation for Steele St. Class EA, with a provisional Level B SUE investigation extending the base scope (Fee Schedule Item 2.1). The Level B investigation involves researching utility locations with utility companies and governmental jurisdictions, collecting utility owner records, coordinating locates, complying with Niagara Region security protocols, providing traffic control per the Ministry of Transportation Ontario Traffic Manual, and designating/recording/marking the horizontal location of existing subsurface utilities using locate methods such as pipe and cable locators, GPR, and acoustic sounding.

pricing_structure.quote: Instructions on How to Provide Pricing (a) Respondents should submit their pricing information electronically within the bidding system. (b) Rates must be provided in Canadian funds, inclusive of all applicable duties and taxes except for HST, which should be itemized separately. (c) Unless otherwise indicated in the requested pricing information, rates quoted by the respondent must be all-inclusive and must include all labour and material costs, all travel and carriage costs, all insurance costs, all costs of delivery, all costs of installation and set-up...
pricing_structure.value: Pricing must be submitted electronically within the bidding system. Rates must be provided in Canadian funds, inclusive of all applicable duties and taxes except for HST, which should be itemized separately. Unless otherwise indicated, rates quoted must be all-inclusive and must include all labour and material costs, all travel and carriage costs, all insurance costs, all costs of delivery, all costs of installation and set-up. Pricing is presented on a Schedule of Prices (Appendix C) with unit prices and/or lump sums per Fee Schedule items, including a 10% Consultant Contingency line item. The lowest stipulated Subtotal Contract Amount in the Summary Table is used for evaluation.
